annotations.title: Get state or provincial annual report rules

description: Call this when a user asks about an LLC or corporation annual report, biennial report, statement of information or annual return: whether it's required in their state or province, when it's due and the state fee. Returns the rule with its official source URL and checked date.

entity.description: Business type. US: sole_prop, single_member_llc, multi_member_llc, partnership, s_corp, c_corp. Canada: sole_prop or corporation.

jurisdiction.description: A US state or Canadian province: two-letter code (TX, ON), US-TX / CA-ON, or the full name. "CA" means California; use "Canada" or a province code for Canada. "US" or "Canada" alone means federal only.

name: get_annual_report_info
title: Get state or provincial annual report rules
